bio: Set in a beautiful, tree-lined location in the suburbs of Liverpool, Allerton Manor offers Afternoon Tea in a tranquil setting with gorgeous views of the golf course.  Seasonal food and a traditional Afternoon Tea menu is served with delightful treats such as carrot cake and glazed strawberry cheesecake for you to enjoy.  Afternoon Tea is served in the Old Stables Restaurant, built on the former stable block and courtyard of the estate and the perfect place to enjoy al fresco dining on their outdoor terrace.
